policy.provenance: Throttle threshold chosen on 84 calibration sessions, seeds 100-111; weights fixed before held-out evaluation.

model.name: Sentinel / TF-IDF sentiment v2
model.similarity: Hashed lexical word/bigram cosine (not semantic embeddings)

protocol.selection_rule: Calibration FP <=5%; maximize detection, then minimize FP, then detection time; ties prefer less sensitivity.
protocol.rate_definition: Fixed 60-second sliding window of admitted requests per key, independently calibrated capacity.
protocol.behavioral_response: Both variants use 2-second throttles; no 30-second block in this ablation. Production policy is unchanged.

dataset_origin: New locally authored challenge families; not an independent teammate dataset
limitations: Virtual-clock replay, not end-to-end HTTP latency.
Settings selected only on calibration; inspected challenge results become regression evidence on subsequent runs.
All variants see the same proposed input sequence; patient clients postpone later inputs after a denial within the fixed time budget.
Ground truth is kept outside the detector. Similar observable behavior can have different intent.
Synthetic confidence and shared generator families limit generalization; independent teammate scenarios remain a separate validation step.
